commitMessage: Bug 285000: [preferences] Add UI option for unused object allocation problem
dslRule:
<!id: unused.throwable.allocation.to.throw>
<!description: Transforms an unused throwable object allocation statement into a throw statement. This typically fixes a compiler warning about an unused object allocation where the object is an exception that should have been thrown.
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: bug-fix, error-prone, problem-fix>

new $Type($args$); :: subtypeOf($Type, "java.lang.Throwable")
=>
throw new $Type($args$);
;;
summary: Transforms an unused `new Throwable(...)` statement into `throw new Throwable(...)`.

commitMessage: add space after links
summary: This commit modifies Javadoc comments to add a space before the closing period after a URL. The TriggerPattern DSL is designed for Java code transformations, not for modifying comments or arbitrary string literals within comments. There is no DSL feature to reliably target and transform such patterns within comment text.

commitMessage: Bug 233156: changed encoding to "UTF-8"
summary: This commit changes a constant declaration from `private static final String UTF8= "UTF8";` to `private static final String UTF_8= "UTF-8";` and updates all usages from `someMethod(UTF8)` to `someMethod(UTF_8)`. The TriggerPattern DSL does not have the capability to perform constant renaming refactorings or to track the resolved string value of an identifier (e.g., `UTF8` as opposed to the string literal `"UTF8"`) for use in guards like `matchesAny` or `isCharsetString`. Therefore, this transformation cannot be safely and accurately expressed by the current DSL.
